brief.headline: Black Friday, a cold weekend and Advent Sunday: three days to turn discount noise into January design bookings.
brief.summary: Friday is Black Friday, and most UK adults doubt the deals, so the winning move is a calm, priced alternative that sends people to the free 3D studio. Saturday is a cold weekend at home when couples browse renovation ideas together: give them the cost answer they are searching for and a studio session to try. Sunday is Advent Sunday, the natural start for a December series that keeps the brand in feeds until January, when bathroom planning peaks. Film Saturday's and Sunday's pieces on Friday.

trends.name: Black Friday scepticism
trends.what_it_is: Black Friday is Friday 27 November; Cyber Monday is 30 November.
trends.why_now: Barclays (23 Nov): 71% of UK adults question whether discounts are genuine, 72% say it is more marketing than sales, 36% are more likely to wait for another sale.
trends.how_we_use_it: A calm, honest alternative: no 'was' prices, a real room priced to the pound, a free design as the offer.

trends.name: Cost questions as the hook
trends.what_it_is: Turning the most-asked question ('how much does a bathroom cost?') into the first line of a post.
trends.why_now: Volume (25 Nov): turning a viewer comment into the hook earns a median 13x for home accounts. UK cost guides updated this month (MyJobQuote, 5 Nov) put a standard fitted bathroom at £6,000 to £8,000 and premium at £11,000 to £15,000.
trends.how_we_use_it: Answer the cost question with sources, then show what each budget looks like in the studio.

trends.name: Appointment timestamps
trends.what_it_is: One appointment filmed from arrival to departure, a timestamp on each clip.
trends.why_now: Added by Later on 13 Nov and still trending the week of 17 Nov (Chatfuel). Later flags it for service businesses.
trends.how_we_use_it: 'Designing a bathroom in 3D, 7:41 pm to 7:49 pm': a homeowner's evening with the studio, from sofa to finished render.

trends.name: Cold snap and the January price cap
trends.what_it_is: Below-average temperatures this week and an energy price cap rise of 26% from 1 January.
trends.why_now: Met Office (23 Nov) and Ofgem (25 Nov).
trends.how_we_use_it: Warm-floor and towel-rail moments for the weekend: 'POV: heated tiles at 6 am'.

trends.name: POV format
trends.why_now: Postdom (checked 23 Nov) lists POV as peaking on TikTok, with the most-viewed example at 59.3M views.
trends.how_we_use_it: 'POV: you just stepped onto heated tiles at 6 am.' Sensory, short, easy to film.

trends.name: Advent countdown series
trends.what_it_is: Advent Sunday is 29 November and Advent calendars start on 1 December. 'Day 1 of 24' countdown series are a running Christmas interiors format.
trends.why_now: NewEngen's Christmas trends round-up lists countdown series among this season's home formats.
trends.how_we_use_it: 'Bathroom Advent': 24 days of design decisions, each one a save-worthy tip that leads to the studio.

trends.name: Plan over Christmas, renovate in January
trends.what_it_is: People plan home projects in the quiet week after Christmas; UK bathroom design searches peak in January.
trends.why_now: Pinterest: 'home organisation ideas' searches rise 75% between Christmas and New Year; Bathroom Review reports UK 'bathroom design' searches peak in January.
trends.how_we_use_it: Start collecting January leads now: 'Design it over Christmas, fit it in the new year.'

ideas.title: What a bathroom really costs in the UK in 2026
ideas.hook: How much does a new bathroom cost in 2026? Here are the real numbers.

ideas.why_it_works: Cost is the top search question around bathrooms and cost carousels get saved and sent. Citing sources builds trust; the studio offers the personal answer.

ideas.why_it_works: Countdown series give people a reason to come back daily, and the DM list becomes the January lead list. Each daily tip is a reusable Pinterest pin.

ideas.title: Built once: the slow bathroom
ideas.trend: Plan over Christmas, renovate in January
ideas.hook: Most people renovate a bathroom every 8 to 10 years. Make the next one the last for a long time.
ideas.concept: The 'slow bathroom' idea from this year's trade forecasts: renovate once, properly. Five decisions that make a bathroom last (proper tanking, quality brassware, timeless layout, good ventilation, easy-clean surfaces), each linked to how the studio and the fitting team handle it.
ideas.why_it_works: A premium counter-message to Black Friday weekend that is save-worthy and positions the brand on quality without claiming anything it cannot prove.

slides.headline: Built once
slides.body: UK homeowners typically renovate every 8 to 10 years (Sanctuary OnePoll, Jan 2026). Make yours last.

slides.headline: Waterproof everything
slides.body: Proper tanking behind every wet wall. You never see it; you'd notice if it was missing.

slides.headline: Buy brassware once
slides.body: Solid, serviceable taps and valves outlast fashionable ones.

slides.headline: Choose a layout you won't outgrow
slides.body: Walk-in showers and wall-hung pieces suit every stage of life.

slides.headline: Let it breathe
slides.body: Good ventilation is the difference between fresh and mouldy in five years.

slides.headline: Make it easy to clean
slides.body: Fewer grout lines, wall-hung WCs, sealed stone.

slides.headline: Designed, supplied and fitted by one team
slides.body: So the design you approve is the room that gets built.

moments: Not Small Business Saturday UK (that's 5 December)

days.prep: Friday and Saturday: plan all 24 Advent decisions, design the launch carousel and first three days, set the ADVENT DM sequence, film the laptop-by-the-tree shot.

watch_outs: Do not imply other companies' Black Friday deals are fake; talk only about how we work.
Cost carousels: put the source and month on every price, and swap in our own price bands once they are confirmed.
January fitting: confirm real availability before promising fit dates [CONFIRM].
Small Business Saturday UK is 5 December; do not post for it on 28 November.
Comment-keyword automations only reply once per person per post and within 7 days; test DESIGN, COST, ADVENT and JANUARY before posting.
Use real project footage only with written client permission.
